== Hero Usage == 
* The [[AI]] will let Aura of the Lich expire before recasting it, not utilizing it to the fullest.

== Notes ==
* Aura of the Lich does not target a corpse, and is unaffected by equipping a [[Bloodstained Insignia]].
* This skill is the only way to raise a [[minion]] without any corpses being available. [[Malign Intervention]] creates a masterless minion when the foe dies.
* The +1 Death Magic buff activates after any minions are summoned.
* The skill indeed exploits ''all'' corpses in range regardless of how many minions the caster's allowed to control, in this case the extra minions will die immediately.
** This will often replenish the caster's energy provided they have points in [[Soul Reaping]].

== Trivia ==
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] is the [[Undead Lich]] and this skill is likely named after him, though he doesn't use it.
